speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand that the exam was aborted due to the muscle tension, which is a classic sign of vaginismus. Does this involuntary tightening occur every time you attempt penetration, and have you ever been able to have painless intercourse in the past?

speaker: Doctor
text:
This presentation is highly consistent with vaginismus, a condition characterized by involuntary pelvic floor muscle spasms that prevent penetration. Since the primary barrier is muscular tension rather than organic disease, I will proceed with the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Vaginismus
